channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: DPS troopers clash with protesters outside South Texas ICE detention facility
item.description: Texas Department of Public Safety troopers used a chemical irritant against demonstrators, who were protested the detention of a five-year-old boy.

item.title: Returning to the moon (Jan. 29, 2026)
item.description: On Thursday's show: We take a closer look at the upcoming Artemis II mission, which will send American astronauts around the moon for the first time in decades.

item.title: One dead, following fatal officer-involved shooting at METRORail platform
item.description: The deputy who was injured is 33 years old and has been working for the sheriff’s office for nine years. He was transported to the hospital and is in stable condition, according to the sheriff’s office.

item.title: Voters see longer wait times during extended early voting in 18th Congressional District. Here’s why
item.description: All ballots cast during the extended early voting hours are provisional, to comply with federal law.

item.title: Gov. Abbott orders Texas universities, agencies to halt H-1B visa petitions
item.description: The governor said public universities and state agencies may not seek new visas without Texas Workforce Commission permission through the end of the 2027 legislative session.

item.title: Another federal lawsuit filed against Harris County details man’s mental struggles, death in jail
item.description: The lawsuit filed Thursday ahead of the anniversary of McGregor's death asserts he stopped eating, drinking and showering as his mental health deteriorated inside the jail.

item.title: At least 12 dead in Texas, nearly half of them children, as winter storm grips state
item.description: A majority of the victims in Texas were children. Nationally, the storm has reportedly killed at least 50 people.

item.title: Hello Houston (January 29, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss the latest on the Artemis II mission, learn about Houston Grand Opera’s production of “Hansel and Gretel,” and talk with Texas State Representative James Talarico about his run for Senate.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (January 29, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters – we have “The Commuter Cut” – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Talarico says Crockett told him she was “looking at running in 2030” before entering 2026 Senate race
item.description: James Talarico said Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett had told him she was “focused on her work in the Congress and was looking at running in 2030” when asked if she had planned to run in the upcoming Senate primary.
